title: 45°: the cosine arc above the classical line
summary: On the Bell state |Φ⁺⟩ two in-plane directions at angle θ have correlation cos θ, while a toy hidden-direction model draws the straight line 1 − 2θ/π: they meet at 0°, 90° and 180°, and at 45° the arc stands 0.207 higher. With Alice on Z and X and Bob's right-angled pair turned by 45°, three pairs sit 45° apart and the fourth 135°, so the four cosines stack to 2√2 ≈ 2.828 where the line gives 2. Turning Bob's pair from 0° to 90°, the value is 2√2 cos(φ − 45°): 2 at both ends, 2√2 only at 45°, while the toy model stays at 2. Each of the sixteen deterministic answer tables gives exactly ±2, and Lean checks that every finite deterministic local model stays within |S| ≤ 2. Lean checks the Landau identity S² = 4 − [A₀, A₁] ⊗ [B₀, B₁]; for qubit directions the commutators are oriented areas, and at right angles the square reaches 8. Lean checks that the fixed 45° operator reaches 2√2 on the Bell state and that no state goes higher: a factor of √2 over the classical bound.
summary_zh: 在贝尔态 |Φ⁺⟩ 上，同一平面内夹角为 θ 的两个方向，关联是 cos θ；一个均匀隐方向玩具模型画出的却是直线 1 − 2θ/π：两者在 0°、90°、180° 重合，到 45° 弧高出 0.207。Alice 取 Z 与 X，Bob 把自己的直角一对转过 45°：三对相隔 45°，第四对相隔 135°，四个余弦叠到 2√2 ≈ 2.828，折线只叠到 2。把 Bob 的一对从 0° 转到 90°，值按 2√2 cos(φ − 45°) 起落：两端是 2，只在 45° 到 2√2，玩具模型一路停在 2。十六张确定性应答表每张都恰好给出 ±2，Lean 检验了任何有限确定性局域模型都满足 |S| ≤ 2。Lean 检验了 Landau 恒等式 S² = 4 − [A₀, A₁] ⊗ [B₀, B₁]；对单比特方向，换位子是有向面积，两侧都张成直角时平方到 8。Lean 检验了固定的 45° 算子在贝尔态上达到 2√2、任何态都超不过：比经典上界高出 √2 倍。
